newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Bamerindus rescue plan in the making - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Bamerindus rescue plan in the making - paper.

text.p: A plan to restructure private Brazilian bank Bamerindus calls for Senator Jose Eduardo de Andrade Vieira to give up control of the bank, a financial newspaper said.

Under the plan being negotiated with the Central Bank, Vieira would agree that a group of professionals would take over from him the administration of the pension fund, Fundacao Bamerindus de Assistencia Social, which controls the bank effectively, Gazeta Mercantil said.

At the same time, financial advisers would be contracted to restructure Bamerindus' finances, draw up a recovery plan and define a model for the sale of Bamerindus' shares in preparation for a future sale of the bank, Gazeta said.

The plan also includes measures to transfer a controlling stake of voting shares to a third-party institution which would act as a trustee until the entire restructuring process has been completed, the newspaper said.
Gazeta said Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation, which holds 6.14 percent of Bamerindus' shares, had been asked to act as the trustee.
In recent months Bamerindus, Brazil's fourth largest private bank, has been struggling to recover liquidity and restore public confidence.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
